Reduced real RageWars provider-order payloads.

measured.h retains all four measured declarations from common/draft_fields_func_8026DC24_de.h.
The first declaration also starts the failed func_8043705C_de preprocessed publication.
scalar.h is the actual types.h provider. folded.c reduces the failed publication to its
measured/scalar import order and an empty function; the body is irrelevant to the parse failure.

placed.h retains the exact Shared_Placed declaration from the failed shared validation
context and the current authored scalar/Vec3 include closure. vec.h retains the real
Vec3 typedef, definition and provenance comments from common/types_8a8189af7b05.h.
The Vec3 closure currently passes native preprocessing; its retained old context lacked it.
